# First page

Fixture page for browser tests. It is not an example.

## Selection target

The target paragraph may change when the test agent edits it. Tests select this paragraph together with the diagram edge below.

<Diagram id="fixture-flow" caption="Fixture flow." draw={(d) => {
  const a = d.box("Source")
  const b = d.box("Target")
  d.row([a, b])
  d.arrow(a, b, { id: "fixture-edge", label: "edge" })
}} />

```ts
export const value = 1;
export const longer = ["a line of about ninety columns", "that needs the wide track"];
```

}} />
